ana_04.code:
pairs=[("ARWU","CWUR",0.853),("THE","ARWU",0.793),("THE","CWUR",0.759),
       ("THE","QS",0.735),("ARWU","QS",0.647),("CWUR","QS",0.599)]
for a,b,s in sorted(pairs,key=lambda x:-x[2]):
    print(f"{a} vs {b}: Spearman={s:.3f}")
m=max(pairs,key=lambda x:x[2]); l=min(pairs,key=lambda x:x[2])
print(f"MOST alike: {m[0]}-{m[1]} {m[2]:.3f} | LEAST alike: {l[0]}-{l[1]} {l[2]:.3f}")
ana_04.expected_stdout:
ARWU vs CWUR: Spearman=0.853
THE vs ARWU: Spearman=0.793
THE vs CWUR: Spearman=0.759
THE vs QS: Spearman=0.735
ARWU vs QS: Spearman=0.647
CWUR vs QS: Spearman=0.599
MOST alike: ARWU-CWUR 0.853 | LEAST alike: CWUR-QS 0.599
ana_04.note: Exact: the six pairwise Spearman correlations on the 218-school core (ana_04); most alike ARWU-CWUR, least CWUR-QS.
